title: Sunday · page eighty
logline: The estuary at high tide, two tiers. Tier three, ink: page eighty of eighty. The hand setting down the pen. The check will come Thursday. The basement tier's last appearance.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the estuary at high tide, September, the mud gone under, the water gray-green and full, the heron's place empty.

panels.composition: Tier 3, ink: the hand, the cramped page — page 80 — and the pen being set down beside it. The register man in the last panel of it, walking out of a door. Caption.
